in_sanskrit.name: Gyanu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Knowledge, Wise
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Gyanu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Gyanu is a Sanskrit name derived from the root 'gyan' meaning 'knowledge'. The name signifies one who is wise, learned, and knowledgeable. It is a name of great reverence and respect, often given to children who are expected to carry on the family's intellectual legacy.
